name: Movement Routine
description: A short routine of gentle moves, one at a time, with a calm timer. Install a routine pack to fill it. Your place is saved, so you can stop whenever you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A short routine of gentle moves shown one at a time, with an optional calm timer. The moves come from a routine pack.
help.goal: There is nothing to win. Do as many moves as you like, and stop whenever you like.
howToPlay: Read the move and its steps. A small picture shows whether it is seated or standing.
For timed moves, press Start timer when you are ready. Press Pause timer to stop it.
Press Next when you have finished a move, or Skip to leave it out.
Press Back to return to the previous move.

controls.action: Back or next, when the move card is focused
Reach Back, the timer, Next and Skip

tips: These are general ideas for a break, not advice. Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip any move that does not suit you.
The timer stops when Lullshift pauses the activity and picks up where it left off.
